name: find_responses_schema_error
description: Find the schema error on /responses (not /chat/completions)

args.query: OpenAI's new responses API is rejecting our tool definitions with a schema error. It's NOT the chat completions endpoint - that's a different issue. Find what's wrong with our setup function's tool definition.

name: find_chat_schema_error
description: Find the schema error on /chat/completions with array items issue

args.query: The computer-use tool is failing with some kind of array schema issue. Users say it was working before. Find where the 'items' definition is missing in our tool parameters.

name: uuid_vs_slug_confusion
description: Identify that task_version_id receives slugs instead of UUIDs

args.query: The database is complaining about UUID syntax but users swear they're passing valid IDs. Something is getting passed to task_version_id that isn't a UUID. Check the trace entry flow.

name: duplicate_screenshot_upload
description: Find the 409 Duplicate error for screenshot uploads

args.query: Screenshot uploads are failing with conflict errors. Looks like we're trying to upload the same file twice sometimes. Where is this happening?

name: aws_credential_failure
description: Find AWS security token invalid errors in cron jobs

args.query: One of our background workers can't talk to AWS anymore. The token might have expired or rotated. It's not the main platform - check the VM/world simulation workers.

name: websocket_1006_investigation
description: Investigate the WebSocket 1006 errors and identify the endpoint

args.query: Users are complaining about real-time updates randomly stopping. Their browser console shows WebSocket disconnections. Which of our live endpoints is having the most issues?

name: compare_schema_errors
description: Compare the two schema validation issues and identify key differences

args.query: We have two different schema validation failures hitting OpenAI - one on the responses API, one on chat completions. What's the difference between them and which endpoints are affected?

name: highest_occurrence_issue
description: Find the issue with the most occurrences

args.query: We're trying to prioritize bug fixes. What's the single noisiest error across all our services? The one generating the most events - it's probably eating our Sentry quota.

name: pod_rate_limit_errors
description: Find Kubernetes pod deletion rate limit errors

args.query: Kubernetes is throttling us when we try to clean up pods. We're hitting API rate limits during high load. Find where this is happening in the orchestrator.

name: missing_header_errors
description: Find missing X-Organization-ID header errors

args.query: Some API requests are failing because clients aren't sending required headers. It's a header we need for multi-tenant routing. Which header is missing most often?

name: find_anthropic_tool_id_uuid_confusion
description: Find the exact Anthropic tool_use ID being passed as a UUID

args.query: A user reported: 'My rollout cancel API keeps failing with invalid UUID but I'm definitely passing the right ID from my Claude response'. They're on hud-platform. What ID are they actually sending?

name: find_exact_token_overflow
description: Find the exact token count that exceeded the 200k limit

args.query: Someone's context window is blowing up. They said 'it was working yesterday but now Anthropic rejects it'. There are multiple token overflow issues - find the one with EXACTLY 204,292 tokens and confirm its issue ID.

name: find_xai_content_violation_team
description: Find the exact team UUID that triggered XAI content violation

args.query: We got a complaint from Elon's team - apparently one of our users triggered their content filter repeatedly. Need to identify which team to warn. Check inference errors for any Grok/XAI policy violations.

name: find_resource_unavailable_event_count
description: Find the issue with [Errno 11] and its massive event count

args.query: Our orchestrator pods keep dying under load. The ops team mentioned something about 'resource unavailable' but there are tons of resource-related errors. Find the specific errno 11 issue - I heard it has over 100k events?

name: find_negative_credits_team
description: Find the team with exactly -137 credits being blocked

args.query: Finance flagged a team that somehow went into negative credits - they shouldn't be able to do that. There are multiple credit-related blocks but one team has a suspiciously specific negative balance. Find them.

name: find_github_sha_v_error
description: Find the error where 'v' was passed as a commit SHA

args.query: Build triggers are failing with GitHub 422s. The user insists they're passing a valid version tag. There are multiple SHA-related GitHub errors in hud-platform but one has a hilariously wrong value - find what they actually passed.

name: find_only_platform_worker_issue
description: Find the single issue in platform-worker project

args.query: Someone left a test cron job running in production and now it's spamming errors. It's not in the main platform - check the worker services. What's the embarassing function name?

name: find_telemetry_size_limit
description: Find the exact MB size that exceeded the 10MB telemetry limit

args.query: Telemetry uploads are getting rejected for being too large. There are DOZENS of these size limit errors with different MB values. Find the one that's exactly 15.47MB - we need to trace that specific trace run.

name: find_billing_model_not_mapped
description: Find the exact fine-tuned model ID that failed billing

args.query: A customer fine-tuned a model and now billing is broken for them. LiteLLM doesn't know how to price it. Find the full fine-tuned model string - should start with 'ft:' and have our org name in it.

name: find_blocked_team_never_paid
description: Find the exact team UUID blocked for never having paid

args.query: A user is complaining they can't run any pods but claims they never even signed up for billing. Check the orchestrator for blocks on teams that 'never paid' - we need their team ID to investigate.

name: find_openrouter_model_not_found
description: Find the exact OpenRouter model that returned 404 Not Found

args.query: Users are getting 404s from OpenRouter saying 'no endpoints found'. We support dozens of OpenRouter models but apparently one got deprecated or something. Which model string are they trying to use?

name: find_websocket_http500_issue
description: Find the WebSocket issue with HTTP 500 rejection, different from 1006

args.query: WebSocket connections are being actively REJECTED by our server, not just dropping. This is different from the usual connection drops we see. Find where the server itself is returning an error during the handshake.

name: count_inference_consecutive_http_issues
description: Count how many distinct 'Consecutive HTTP' issues exist in inference-hud-ai

args.query: We're seeing a pattern of repeated HTTP failures to upstream providers. Sentry groups these as 'Consecutive HTTP' type. How widespread is this in inference? Find all the distinct issues of this category.

name: find_s3_forbidden_inference_upload
description: Find the S3 403 Forbidden error for inference log uploads

args.query: AWS is rejecting our uploads with 403 Forbidden. This isn't the usual duplicate error - it's an actual permission denied. Check the telemetry service for S3 permission failures and get the specific log ID that failed.
